_note: Boons change how abilities and fights work. `refs` names the abilities/stats each boon touches (tested against abilities.json). `lines` limits a boon to class lines; empty = shared. effect keys: flag (read by CombatSim), skill_bonus, run (read by DSRunState), start_status.

concussive_bash.name: Concussive Bash
concussive_bash.desc: Bash also slows the target for 2 rounds.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Each parry adds +5% damage to your next swing, stacking to 5.

patient_knife.name: Patient Knife
patient_knife.desc: Backstab works on wounded targets too.

forked_bolt.name: Forked Bolt
forked_bolt.desc: Chain lightning jumps one extra time.

eye_of_the_storm.name: Eye of the Storm
eye_of_the_storm.desc: Storm dance no longer lowers parry.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: +30% damage against blinded, stunned or knocked-down enemies.

second_skin.name: Second Skin
second_skin.desc: Start every fight warded (armor for 5 rounds).

catch_breath.name: Catch Your Breath
catch_breath.desc: Recover 10% HP and mana after every fight.

war_mender.name: War Mender
war_mender.desc: Warcry also heals 15% of your max HP.

bone_breaker.name: Bone Breaker
bone_breaker.desc: Kick has a 25% chance to stun for a round.

relentless_charge.name: Relentless Charge
relentless_charge.desc: Charge works on wounded targets too.

evasive_counter.name: Evasive Counter
evasive_counter.desc: After you dodge or sidestep, your next swing deals +50% damage.

grit_in_the_eyes.name: Grit in the Eyes
grit_in_the_eyes.desc: Dirt kicking blinds for 2 extra rounds.

cutthroat.name: Cutthroat
cutthroat.desc: Circle works on badly wounded targets too.

crushing_fist.name: Crushing Fist
crushing_fist.desc: Magic fist deals +50% damage to enemies above half HP.

lingering_ward.name: Lingering Ward
lingering_ward.desc: Shield and armor last twice as long.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.desc: Each kill restores 10% of your mana.

mist_walker.name: Mist Walker
mist_walker.desc: Mist dance only costs a third of your damage instead of two thirds.

whirling_blades.name: Whirling Blades
whirling_blades.desc: Whirlwind always strikes each enemy at least twice.

cobra_strike.name: Cobra Strike
cobra_strike.desc: In cobra dance, every parry triggers a counter-swing.

bleeding_cross.name: Bleeding Cross
bleeding_cross.desc: Cross slash leaves the target bleeding for 3 rounds.

storm_caller.name: Storm Caller
storm_caller.desc: Storm of blades no longer needs the storm dance.

first_blood.name: First Blood
first_blood.desc: Your first hit in each fight deals double damage.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: Once per fight, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc: Each kill in a fight adds +10% damage for the rest of it.

deep_pockets.name: Deep Pockets
deep_pockets.desc: Carry 2 more potions of each kind, and get one HP potion now.

spiked_hide.name: Spiked Hide
spiked_hide.desc: Enemies that hit you in melee take damage back.

keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
keen_edge.desc: Your weapon counts as sharp (+15% damage).
